app.degraded_mode_body: Tauri bridge unavailable — settings + sessions are in-memory only.

general.title: General Settings
general.description: Configure timer durations and basic behavior
general.language_help: Changes apply immediately — no restart needed.
general.focus_duration_help: How long should focus sessions last
general.break_duration_help: Duration for short breaks between focus sessions
general.long_break_duration_help: Duration for long breaks after completing a cycle
general.total_sessions_help: Number of focus sessions to complete each day
general.sessions_per_long_break_help: How many focus sessions before a long break
general.max_session_time_help: Maximum time per session before auto-pause (default: 2 hours)

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Control how and when you receive notifications
notifications.desktop_help: Show system notifications when timer completes.
notifications.sound_help: Play a sound when timer phases complete
notifications.metronome_help: Play a soft tick every second while a focus session is running, in sync with the timer countdown.
notifications.ambient_help: Loop a chosen ambient track while a focus session is running. Fades in on resume, fades out on pause/break/overtime.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Customize the appearance and visual style of the application
theme.mode_help: Choose your preferred color theme. Auto will automatically switch between light and dark mode based on your system preferences.
theme.timer_theme_help: Choose a color theme for your timer sessions.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: Configure automatic behaviors and smart features
automation.auto_start_help: Automatically start the timer when manually skipping to the next session.
automation.continuous_help: Allow all sessions to continue beyond their timer duration.
automation.smart_pause_help: Automatically pause the timer during focus sessions when no activity is detected.
automation.inactivity_timeout_help: How long to wait before pausing during inactivity
automation.auto_save_help: Automatically save session data when timer completes.
automation.prevent_interruptions_help: Show confirmation dialog before allowing session resets during active focus periods.

goals.title: Weekly Goals
goals.description: Set your weekly focus time targets and productivity goals
goals.weekly_help: Target focus time for Monday through Friday (default: 125 minutes = 5 sessions of 25 minutes). Saturday and Sunday are excluded from calculation.

shortcuts.title: Global Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts that work even when the app is in the background
shortcuts.desc_start_stop: Start or pause the current Pomodoro session.
shortcuts.desc_reset: Discard the current session without counting it.
shortcuts.desc_skip: Save the current session and start the next one.
shortcuts.desc_abort: Discard the current focus session without logging it.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Danger zone and advanced configuration options
advanced.autostart_help: Automatically start Presto when your computer boots up.
advanced.hide_icon_help: Hide the app icon from the dock when closing the window with X.
advanced.status_bar_help: Choose how the timer information is displayed in the system status bar/tray.
advanced.debug_help: Enable debug mode where all timers are set to 3 seconds for rapid testing.
advanced.danger_description: These actions are irreversible and will permanently delete your data.
advanced.reset_help: This will permanently delete all your Pomodoro sessions, tasks, statistics, and reset all settings to default. This action cannot be undone.
advanced.reset_dialog_body: This will permanently delete all your sessions, tags, and settings.

updates.title: App Updates
updates.description: Manage application updates and version information
updates.auto_check_help: Check for new versions automatically when the app starts.
updates.prerelease_help: Also check for beta and pre-release versions.

timer.ctrl_skip_mode_aria: Skip current mode and advance to the next phase
timer.ctrl_abort_aria: Abort the current session without counting it
timer.ctrl_note_distraction_aria: Capture a distraction note for the current session
timer.ctrl_complete_aria: Complete the current session and advance
timer.indicator_smart_pause: Smart Pause: Click to toggle automatic pause when inactive
timer.indicator_auto_start: Auto-start: Click to toggle automatic session start
timer.indicator_continuous: Continuous Sessions: Click to toggle continuous mode

messages.break_completed_desktop_long_break: Long break finished — back to focus
messages.overtime_started_toast_focus: Pomodoro completed! Continue working or take a break 🍅
messages.overtime_started_toast_break: Break time completed! Continue resting or ready to focus? ☕
messages.overtime_started_toast_long_break: Long break completed! Continue resting or ready to work? 🌙
messages.overtime_started_desktop_break: Break over — continue resting or get back to work
messages.overtime_started_desktop_long_break: Long break over — continue resting or get back to work
messages.session_skipped_toast_long_break: Long break skipped — back to work 🚀

toast.smart_pause_activated: Smart Pause: timer paused due to inactivity ⏸️
